# Phase 3 · Wave 2 gate report (P3-5 / P3-6 / P3-7 / P3-8 / P3-9)

2026-10-02 · branch `design/three-films` · W2 integrated in `56a9557`, measured in `9a3611f` (estVh) and `bff8750`
(MEASURE + VISUAL + probe fixes), fixed in `133abc0` → `b37e156` → this commit. Headless Chromium 141, 4 CPUs,
SwiftShader (software raster and software GL): read absolute frame numbers as relative. Base = the pre-Phase-3 build
`5aa4587` on :3162.

**Verdict.** **P3-9 passes its W2 gate** (#1–#4; #5, the manual listen, needs a person and goes to Aryan, as plan §10.2
allows): ticked. **P3-6 is not ticked:** 6 of 11 pass and #3 passes its `landAt` half; the rest are a decision (#6 MATCH_ROW), a
wave-3 host (#8 letterbox), or checks that need a real frame rate or the P3-11 judges (#2 skimmer, #3 hooks, #10 seam
pop). The DOM overlays that GL still covers during star (a) are tracked for P3-11. Every MEASURE failure that W2 code could fix is fixed: the loglines show, a hash on
load lands at `landAt` (with and without Lenis), the cards no longer trail the reader by seconds, the fast lane is
under 400 ms in 20 of 27 headless runs (the misses wait on a SwiftShader raster frame), and the parked sections idle at
60 fps without a screencast (under it, the living loops cost by design). P3-5, P3-7 and P3-8 wait for their
wave-3 hosts (plan §10.2 W3).

---

## 1. What shipped

**Wave 2 (`56a9557`, W2-notes):** the four pinned act cards (css tier, the contained WebGL layer, title masks,
loglines as subtitles, push-ins, the kraken), the plates engine (window-mode sequences, weather, camera / depth
facades), the word primitives, the hunt core (12 eggs, chip, panel, 12/12, post-credits), sound (muted by default,
procedural beds and cues, five TTS lines), `landAt` .47 and `maskOrigin`, `systems.pencil.body.p3`.

**The gate fixes (`133abc0`, `b37e156`, this commit):**
- *Loglines (P3-7 #4).* `app/p3/cards.css`: the subtitle's hidden state is now `:where(html.js:not(…) [data-act-card-pin]) .act-card-subtitle` (0,1,0), so `cards-pin.css`'s `[data-card-phase="b"|"m"] .act-card-subtitle { opacity: 1 }` (0,2,0) wins. It was (0,4,1) and the line never showed.
- *Hash on load (P3-2 #2, P3-6 #3).* `lib/smooth-scroll.ts`: a load-time hash on the desktop motion path is **held** (first at `load`, retried until a streamed target is placed, then at every refresh) until the visitor scrolls, clicks or jumps. It no longer depends on a ScrollTrigger existing (none does in W2; the cards pin with CSS sticky), and the "within 1.5 vh" guard that left `#work` at 0 is gone. `cardTravel()` now uses p_raw's own range (pin − innerHeight, review #6). Same-page `#` links route through `scrollToTarget` with or without Lenis (`useAnchors`, `smooth-scroll-impl.tsx`), so `?skip=smooth` anchors land at `landAt` too.
- *Damping (VISUAL HIGH 2, judge HIGH 3, P3-6 #2).* `card-p3.tsx` `useDamping`: dt is capped at 250 ms (`cardPin.dtMax`), so the lag is in real time, not in frames (at the old 64 ms cap a 3 fps headless frame rate left the card seconds behind); a p_raw step ≥ .5 in one scroll event (scrollbar drag, Home / End, a script) snaps (`cardPin.jump`); inside each scroll star the damped p's speed is capped at span / 0.4 s (`cardPin.starMinS`), so a skimmer's fling still shows each star ≥ 400 ms; Pause stops the loop in the same task (review #3).
- *Pause and reduced motion (review #2).* The kraken's swell (WAAPI tip, mass, plate heave, `animate(kraken)`), the impact shake / flash / bloom and the chalk puff are tracked and cancelled from `onMotionOffChange` (`lib/impact.ts trackImpactAnim`); the long-look dwell re-checks motion, `live` and the eggs before it plays.
- *Kraken hint (review #4, P3-8 #2).* The "HERE BE MONSTERS" button renders only on a card that pins, inside `<EggHint egg="hidden-kraken">`, and is bound by delegation on the section.
- *Pin gate (review #5).* `card-shell.tsx`: OS reduced motion keeps the card out of pin mode (no driver, GL, stars or lazy CSS work for a static card).
- *Small review findings.* `hunt-store.ts` (#7: a blocked `setItem` keeps the view's own copy, so a find counts and toasts once), `seqWindow` (#8: a `tick` redraws the SEQ canvas when the asked frame decodes), `WeatherCue` (#9: paused outside its range and before the pin, which also ends the hero's idle weather repaint), `hotspots.ts` (#10: a hold's swallow ends with its own press).
- *Visual (VISUAL MEDIUM 3 / 5 / 6, LOW 7, LOW 10; judge HIGH 1 / 2 / 4).* The css title mask zooms to p .88, then **exits by state** (a 300 ms fade) and the clean plate holds to p 1, so no reader rest keeps a giant half-letter; the world outside the letters dims to a third instead of black, so the push dives into the title rather than cutting away. The opening hook's iris disc (12 % of the diagonal) now sits wholly inside the frame, rim included (`pin-build.ts`; the push still dives at the stern). The chalk FIG label sets on two lines on DESKTOP_FINE (`board-fig.tsx`; phones and tablets keep the one line). Pinned cards fade the outgoing caption by the meet (`card-captions.tsx` `PIN_OUT`; passage cards unchanged). The hunt chip has a hover hint (its own aria-label line).
- *GL settle (P3-6 #4 / #10).* The settled GL pass fades to clear over .45–.50 (`uFade`, `lib/gl/plan.ts` + `shaders.ts`), so FIG. 0, Rancho's circle, the embers and the sun come up under it instead of popping in at .50.
- *Probe tools.* `cards.mjs` waits for the four pin drivers (they mount 0.8–1.6 s after load headless), reads the damping's early sample after p_raw has moved, and polls up to 6 s for a streamed hash target (recording `landedMs`).

| run | P3-0 | W1 (fix) | base today (M) | W2 before the gate (M) | **W2 gate** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| desktop (Lenis) fps / p95 / CLS / pops | 15.2 / 316.7 / 0 / 27 | 19.0 / 216.6 / .0047 / 1 | 12.3 / 333.4 / 0 / 22 | 11.8 / 300 / .0037 / 0 | **12.7 / 300 / .0039 / 3** |
| native fps / CLS | – | 15.8 / .0032 | – | 8.1 / .0033 | **9.0 / .0152** (one 0.0134 session: world-font swaps on the work captions, deferred #31) |
| 1024 desktop fps / p95 / CLS / pops | – | 15.8 / – / .0024 / – | – | 17.7 / 200.1 / .0052 / 5 | **19.6 / 166.7 / .0049 / 6** |
| card transitions act-1…4 fps (desktop 1440) | – | 22.9 · 28.3 · 28.3 · 31.6 (unpinned) | 21.1 · 11.2 · 21.1 · 21.7 | 4.4 · 8.4 · 7.9 · 13.5 | **4.6 · 6.7 · 16.3 · 16.1** |
| card transitions (native 1440) | – | – | – | 1.9 · 4.5 · 7.4 · 7.6 | **4.3 · 3.9 · 7.8 · 6.3** |
| card transitions (desktop 1024) | – | – | – | 7.8 · 10.4 · 22.4 · 20.9 | **8.2 · 15.0 · 26.7 · 27.3** |

| idle fps under the screencast (`motion.js`) | none < 55 | none < 55 | top 60.2, act-1 60.4, journey 39.1 (base, `F/idlecast.log`) | top 41.6, act-1 29.3, journey 8.0 | **top 37–50, act-1 20–24, journey 51–60** at 1440; 1024: act-1 47, journey 47, the rest ≥ 60 |

- **The idle drops left are the living plates by design** (P3-5): with the hero's MV-03 and the opening's L01 loop playing, a parked frame pays video decode + composite + the screencast readback in software. With `?gl=off` or `?skip=stage` act-1 reads the same (18.8–18.9 fps), so it is the loop, not GL or the stage. The weather repaint MEASURE saw at the top and act-1 is gone (0 raster ms/s at act-1).
- **Pinned transitions stay raster-bound** headless (97–99 % of LoAF time waiting on the compositor; GL beats css). The act-3 and act-4 transitions doubled; act-1 and act-2 are unchanged within noise.
- **Fast lane** (P3-2 #2, W1's): 20 of 27 headless runs ≤ 400 ms (cold, 3 s after Lenis: 163–203 ms in 9 of 9; warm: 184–416; `nav.cjs`: 282–842; the lenis probe: 305 @1024, 422 and 1635 @1440). Focus moves at ≈ 165 ms; a miss is the rAF observer waiting out the 1.2–1.5 s SwiftShader raster frame of the new viewport (2–5 ms of main-thread work in it), with GL off and with the stage off alike (`F/fastcold.log`).
- **GL context creation (P3-6 #4):** 0 LoAFs over 50 ms by work in 2 of 2 re-runs (`F/misc.log`; MEASURE had 1 of 2). The context job and a link are single SwiftShader calls; a real laptop settles it.
- **Bundle (P3-2 #10, rule 34):** first load **JS +4,440 B gz, CSS +5,303 B gz** against base (budget 6,144; `F/probes-1024` bundle.compare; +4,257 / +5,303 before the hash-hold code). gsap, lenis and ScrollTrigger stay lazy (50.1 KB gz). Headroom for wave 3: ≈ 1.7 KB gz JS, ≈ 0.84 KB gz CSS. The lazy chunks are unchanged in kind (§6 #5).
- **Rules 33–35:** no new rule matches `<html>` (the subtitle's `:where(html.js…) .act-card-subtitle` styles the subtitle), no substring selectors, nothing keyed on `html.lenis*`; the new layers are opacity / transform only.
- **RELEASE** (`F/release.txt`): 50 errors, all expected: 40 Check L2, 5 TTS approvals, the unsigned list (100), and 4 static beat-pacing estimates that wave 3's hosts and `beats.mjs --write` resolve (B24 → B25 gap at both widths; B06 × B07 1.2 vh and B46 × B47 7.7 vh overlaps, against hosts not built yet).

## 5. Wave-3 handoffs

Appended to `docs/build/p3-handoff/deferred-w3.md` under "Added by the W2 gate". In short:
- **W3-RDR2:** B41 spans 229 px at 1024 (< 300).
- **W3-PIRATES:** JV to window mode (P3-5 #6 is unproven at the journey: legacy frames are not counted by `__seqMem`); the paused-reload `#journey` reflow (P3-2 #11; base does the same).
- **W3-IDIOTS / W3-GAMES:** P3-8 #9 B1 (`chalk.tsx` reads `readSession`), B5, B6.
- **Every W3 host:** six eggs have no trigger yet and the 3i-aal hotspot is unplaced (P3-8 #1).
- **W3-CINEMA:** the letterbox scenes (P3-6 #8).
- **W3 assembler / P3-11.0:** P3-6 #2 skimmer, #10 seam strip and P3-5 #3 SSIM / FIG drift need a real frame rate or a new probe check; P3-6 #3 hooks are judged in P3-11.
- **GL overlays:** the frames' DOM overlays still sit under the GL host through star (a); the pop at .50 is gone (settle fade). Judge it in P3-11 before building GL-matched masks.
- **P3-11 taste calls:** the mask's legibility over dark plate, the iris that grows past the frame, the hooks' idle life, the post-credits tail's contrast and staging.

2. **Approve the five TTS lines** (`public/audio/tts-{lumos,nox,parley,solemn,mischief}`): solemn and mischief need "to approve" (the quotation) and all five "to confirm" (the generic-voice terms) in `public/audio/SOUNDS.md`. They are the five `#9 sound … awaits Aryan` release errors. **DP-9 amendment:** PHASE3-PLAN DP-9 now lists them as expected release failures of the same kind as Check L2; confirm that reading.

4. **`landAt` .47, not the spec's .45:** an act anchor lands inside the settle (.45–.50), with the new world fully shown and the damped p at rest. Keep .47 (and amend spec §7.1's table) or ask for .45.
5. **Lazy chunk sizes over their soft lines** (none touches first load): the GL chunk ≈ 12.8 KB gz over a full desktop scroll (line 8 KB; the spec's estimate left out the lock and plan runtime), the plates engine ≈ 11.0 KB gz (line 8), the audio engine ≈ 10.5–10.7 KB gz (line 10), SEQ-HALL 3.66 MB (line 1.6 MB).
